title: Home screen — the approved image, and the build
question: The first card is the image you approved. The next three are the app itself running on this computer, in English so they compare line for line: the top, the fan, and the day. Approve the build for dev, or say what is still off.

options.label: Approved image
options.thesis: The paper fan with colour only in the icons.
options.viewport: Wordmark, greeting, date, fan, Today, write-anything bar, tabs.

options.label: Build: the top
options.thesis: Wordmark, greeting and date in the order and serif of the image, on the real paper texture.
options.risk: The moon emoji after the greeting is the app's own; the image has none.

options.label: Build: the fan
options.thesis: Seven exactly equal sectors, the paper lit from the top-left, a gold foil rim, colour in the icons only.
options.viewport: The fan and the Day's end seal with the video button inside.
options.risk: The emboss shading is a little heavier than the image on the lower edges.

options.label: Build: the day
options.thesis: Today on the same paper, the day's gold line, then the write-anything bar and the tabs.
options.viewport: Today is empty here because this computer's copy has no schedule logged.
options.risk: The cards further down (reminder, backup) are still the old white ones; the layout strip is dev-only.
